sections.title: Letter T Sound
paragraphs: The letter (T) /t/ is called (T) /t/. Its main sound is the sound /t/, that is a crisp sound, as in (top) /tɑp/, which means top. This letter makes two spoken sounds. Sometimes it makes no sound at all.

sections.title: How To Say
paragraphs: Press the tip of your tongue against the roof of your mouth. Hold the air back. Then release the breath with a sharp puff. Do not use your voice. For the quick tap, bounce the tongue tip lightly against the roof. Hold your hand before your mouth to feel the puff.

sections.title: Spelling Rules
paragraphs: This letter usually makes the sound /t/, that is a crisp sound, as in (ten) /tɛn/. Between vowels before an unstressed syllable, it makes the sound /ɾ/, that is a quick flap, as in (butter) /bʌ.tər/. In words with letters s, t, l or s, t, e, n, it makes no sound, as in (listen) /lɪs.ən/.

sections.title: Common Mistakes
paragraphs: Do not voice this crisp sound like the sound in dog. Keep your vocal cords still. Do not blow too much air when the sound sits at the end of a word. When you say the fast flap, do not stop the air fully. Tap your tongue quickly without stopping the flow.
